title: Kundalini Spells Apothecary
description: A stylized geometric portrait of a woman with a patterned face featuring red and blue triangles and spiral motifs, shown in profile looking upward. She emerges beside an ornate wooden apothecary window displaying a sign reading 'KUNDALINI SPELLS Geometric Muse in Bloom Slot 5', hanging dried herbs, a scroll with sacred geometry, potion jars labeled 'Dream', 'Clarity', and 'Bloom', and a decorated snake, all set against a backdrop of angular glowing mountains and twisting vines.
prompt: Surreal geometric portrait of a woman in profile with a face composed of blue and orange triangles and hypnotic spirals, positioned beside an ornate wooden apothecary alcove. Inside the alcove is a sign that reads 'KUNDALINI SPELLS Geometric Muse in Bloom Slot 5', a hanging bundle of dried herbs, an unrolled scroll with sacred geometry patterns, three potion jars labeled Dream Clarity and Bloom, and a patterned snake. The scene is framed by twisting green vines with flowers and set against sharp angular mountains glowing with orange light at dusk.
